mapper.select: SELECT d.source_detail_id AS sourceDetailId, IFNULL(SUM(d.apply_qty), 0) AS appliedQty FROM mis_stock_in_detail d INNER JOIN mis_stock_in m ON m.id = d.stock_in_id WHERE m.source_order_id = #{orderId} AND m.source_order_type = 'PURCHASE' AND m.approve_status = '0' AND m.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY d.source_detail_id
